inputs.text: pixel art sprite, game asset, 32-bit pixel art. Edit the reference image. Replace the fighter with a completely new character who stands in the same spot with his feet on the same line, at the same body height, in the same three quarter view facing down-left, drawn in the same crisp pixel art style with the same pixel size, dark outlines and light from the upper left. Nothing of the old fighter remains: no human skin, no hair, no metal ribs, no claw arm. The new character is a handsome goth dragonkin warrior, one of the Sovereign's hunters: a lean, toned reptilian humanoid with a sleek, good looking dragon head, a short tapered snout, a strong jaw, glowing slit eyes, two small horns swept back from the brow, and two thin flaps of scaled skin hanging down on either side of the chin like a goatee. Fine scales cover his face, neck and hands. He wears fitted gothic body armour over his scales. He is the war band's standard bearer: one hand grips a tall war banner on a long pole planted upright on the ground beside him, the flag hanging high above his head, and his other arm carries a shield. No wings. Colours: pale bone white scales, black lacquered armour with silver edges, a black banner with a bone white sigil, a black shield with a bone white rim. Full body and the whole banner inside the image with clear margins. One character only. Plain flat uniform blue grey (#56616c) background, no floor, no shadow, no text.
